title_en: Notice of Decision on Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: T&D Holdings announced on 4 June 2026 that its board of directors has authorized a treasury-stock acquisition programme. The company will acquire up to 12,000,000 ordinary shares (2.50% of shares outstanding as at 31 March 2026) within an upper limit of Y30.0 billion. The acquisition will be executed via ToSTNeT-3 (negotiated off-market trading) commencing 8 June 2026 and concluding 30 September 2026. The stated purposes are to enhance shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency. As of 31 March 2026, the company held 8,134,171 treasury shares (including 2,708,643 shares held in trustee accounts for officer compensation and ESOP schemes) against an issued share base of 479,865,829 shares.
